what: The TIERED gates (Will, 2026-09-26): ALWAYS BANNED = no branch (the target staying, or any switch-in the opponent has) achieves the click's PURPOSE -> removed; MOSTLY BANNED = futile against the body in now, achieved only on a switch -> weighted by the probability of a rescuing switch under the HUMAN switch model (MAG v1 + DODUO v1, scored from the opponent's seat in the gate's world), floored at 0.001, never removed. The purpose is read off the move's data (solver/mag/purpose.js): a guaranteed-flinch damaging move -> the flinch; a status move aimed at a body that applies a status, a stat change or a board-read volatile -> its effect on the target's board; everything else -> MEDICHAM's move result. MAG (per slot) and DODUO's pair gate stay distinct jobs. Written before any measured run; development used seeds 98 and 99 only.

survival_full.sample: 2,000 fully observed joint decisions by TEST-split players, a seeded stride (seed 5: fresh, never used to build or fix the gates)
survival_full.bar: the human's actual joint survives the always-banned tier (MAG dead on neither click, the pair gate does not cut the joint) in >= 99.9% of evaluated decisions (point estimate), AND every loss is a real misclick: its replay shows the click failed or did nothing
survival_full.also_reported: options per purpose x verdict; the verdicts the purpose changed (v_result -> v); the removal fractions and the MAG x pair 2x2 as on 2026-09-25

survival_census.sample: every eligible held-out decision (20,501 at this dataset digest): MAG on the human's own clicks, the pair gate on the human joint
survival_census.bar: as survival_full, on the whole population

mostly_banned_humans.descriptive, no bar: how often a human's click is mostly-banned (share of the human's move clicks, Wilson 95%); its switch-model weight; how often the opponent's ACTUAL joint held a rescuing switch; how often the click achieved its purpose against the opponent's actual joint (the gate's world, either dice set)

arms.x: DODUO v1 argmax over the tiered-gated candidates
arms.y: DODUO v1 argmax over every legal joint

doduo_greedy.bar: read once, at the bound or at 400 games: H1 / H0 / INCONCLUSIVE with the score and its Wilson 95% interval

arms.x: MILTANK gen5 nets, 1,000 ms, k 4x4, depth 0, reserve 1 switch, candidates ranked by the tiered-gated DODUO v2 (gate budget 600 steps / 150 ms a side, inside the 1,000 ms)

miltank.equal_wall_clock: the gate is paid out of the same 1,000 ms

click_rates.instrument: solver/arena/click_rates.js on every match row of the two SPRTs (clicks.x / clicks.y), over the games the SPRT counted
click_rates.rates: Protect repeat rate = Protect-family clicks by a body whose streak is live / Protect-family clicks; immune-hit rate = single-target damaging clicks into a body MEDICHAM's damage function prices at 0 / single-target damaging clicks
click_rates.descriptive, no bar: each rate per arm with a Wilson 95% interval; the prediction, stated before the run, is that the tiered arm's immune-hit rate is no higher than the ungated arm's
